title: A full hopper absorbs a burst. The refill sets the long-run rate.

provenance.source: Authored illustrative model for the STE-Pro Max showcase, October 23, 2026

metaphor.object: A hopper of tokens above a valve
metaphor.status: Illustrative mechanism; the hopper and valve do not exist in any rate limiter

mapping.spout: Refill of r tokens at each 1 s tick, capped at C
mapping.token disc: One unit of permission for one request
mapping.valve: Admission: one token is spent for each admitted request
mapping.reject bin: Requests that find no token in that tick

definitions.r: Tokens added at each 1 s tick
definitions.a: Requests that arrive at each 1 s tick
definitions.tick_order: At each tick: refill first (capped at C), then admit up to the available tokens
definitions.rejected: Requests that find no token; they are not queued or retried

assumptions: Time advances in whole 1 s ticks; arrivals and refill occur once per tick.
Arrivals are constant and identical at every tick.
Each request costs exactly one token.
Rejected requests are dropped; there is no queue, retry, or backoff.
limits: No real requests, clocks, network calls, storage, or automatic playback.
No claim about latency, fairness, distributed limits, or a specific product's limiter.
Whole-second ticks simplify continuous refill; real limiters may refill continuously.
